name: Sara ni Ganbare! Waku Waku Seven!! Ryakushite SGW Ben!!!
original_name: 更に頑張れ！わくわくセビン！！略してSGW便！！！
source:
What a fine day. What a lovely day. 

The SGW uniform boy is here again. 
Those blue and white stripes. SGW Service... 
I think about him all day. His outfit, his brilliance. 
His hardworking sweat. The uniform... 
His smiling face. His voice. 

Unnnn... he takes my breath away... 

Just once is enough. Just once. 

*Ding dong* 

Be still my heart! He's here!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075698.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
多么美好的一天啊。多么美好的一天啊。

SGW制服男孩又来了。
那些蓝白条纹。SGW服务… 
我整天都在想他。他的着装，他的才华。
他辛勤的汗水。制服… 
他的笑脸。他的声音。

嗯……他让我无法呼吸…… 

只要一次就够了。就一次。

*叮咚* 

仍是我的心！他来了！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075698.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
